speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Manpower (Mr Zaqy Mohamad) (for the Minister for Manpower)
text: Hence the responsibility is placed on employers and occupiers to report these injuries, so there are two reporting channels.

speaker: Mr Deputy Speaker
text: Mr Louis Ng, a short supplementary question, please, because we have to end at about 11.00 am.

speaker: Mr Zaqy Mohamad
text: The Member himself, also said in this House during the Committee of Supply that some of our healthcare workers already quite stretched.

speaker: Mr Zaqy Mohamad
text: So, the last thing we want is to add administrative burden to them when we do not really need it.

speaker: Mr Deputy Speaker
text: The Clerk will now proceed to read the Orders of the Day.

speaker: Mr Deputy Speaker
text: [Pursuant to Standing Order No 22(3), provided that Members had not asked for questions standing in their names to be postponed to a later Sitting day or withdrawn, written answers to questions not reached by the end of Question Time are reproduced in the Appendix.]
